facts.business: Riba Textiles Limited is a 100% Export Oriented Unit engaged in the manufacture of terry towels, bath mats and allied home-textile products, serving customers across North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania and India, and also markets a consumer-facing brand SENSES by Riba through e-commerce channels.

segments.name: Export of terry towels and home textiles

key_risks: evolving compliance requirements in key export geographies
